ruleset.name: nitpicker-spring-tests
ruleset.description: Nitpicker Spring rules for test sources.

rule.name: SpringUnusedContext
rule.message: This @SpringBootTest starts the whole application context but uses nothing from it: no injected or mock bean, no MockMvc, WebTestClient, TestRestTemplate, CapturedOutput or ApplicationEvents, and no web server port. Make it a unit test that creates the class with new, or use a slice such as @WebMvcTest for one layer; @SpringBootTest is for integration and component tests. If the context is needed, add an exception for pmd/SpringUnusedContext in nitpicker.config.json.

property.name: xpath
property.value: //ClassDeclaration[not(ExtendsList)] [ModifierList/Annotation[pmd-java:typeIs('org.springframework.boot.test.context.SpringBootTest')] [not(.//MemberValuePair[@Name = 'webEnvironment'] //(FieldAccess | VariableAccess)[@Name = ('RANDOM_PORT', 'DEFINED_PORT')])]] [not(ModifierList/Annotation[ pmd-java:typeIs('org.springframework.boot.test.mock.mockito.MockBean') or pmd-java:typeIs('org.springframework.boot.test.mock.mockito.MockBeans') or pmd-java:typeIs('org.springframework.boot.test.mock.mockito.SpyBean') or pmd-java:typeIs('org.springframework.boot.test.mock.mockito.SpyBeans') or pmd-java:typeIs('org.springframework.test.context.bean.override.mockito.MockitoBean') or pmd-java:typeIs('org.springframework.test.context.bean.override.mockito.MockitoBeans') or pmd-java:typeIs('org.springframework.test.context.bean.override.mockito.MockitoSpyBean') or pmd-java:typeIs('org.springframework.test.context.bean.override.mockito.MockitoSpyBeans')])] [let $injection := ( 'org.springframework.beans.factory.annotation.Autowired', 'org.springframework.beans.factory.annotation.Value', 'org.springframework.beans.factory.annotation.Qualifier', 'jakarta.inject.Inject', 'javax.inject.Inject', 'jakarta.annotation.Resource', 'javax.annotation.Resource', 'jakarta.persistence.PersistenceContext', 'org.springframework.boot.test.mock.mockito.MockBean', 'org.springframework.boot.test.mock.mockito.SpyBean', 'org.springframework.test.context.bean.override.mockito.MockitoBean', 'org.springframework.test.context.bean.override.mockito.MockitoSpyBean', 'org.springframework.test.context.bean.override.convention.TestBean', 'org.springframework.boot.test.web.server.LocalServerPort', 'org.springframework.boot.test.web.server.LocalManagementPort'), $clients := ( 'org.springframework.test.web.servlet.MockMvc', 'org.springframework.test.web.servlet.assertj.MockMvcTester', 'org.springframework.test.web.reactive.server.WebTestClient', 'org.springframework.boot.test.web.client.TestRestTemplate', 'org.springframework.context.ApplicationContext', 'org.springframework.boot.test.system.CapturedOutput', 'org.springframework.test.context.event.ApplicationEvents') return not(.//(FieldDeclaration | FormalParameter | MethodDeclaration)/ModifierList/Annotation [some $type in $injection satisfies pmd-java:typeIs($type)]) and not(.//(FieldDeclaration | FormalParameter)/ClassType [some $type in $clients satisfies pmd-java:typeIs($type)])] [not(.//ConstructorDeclaration[FormalParameters/@Size > 0])] [.//MethodDeclaration[ModifierList/Annotation[@SimpleName = ('Test', 'ParameterizedTest', 'RepeatedTest')]] [Block/*]]
